"""Root-owned bounded, read-only gateway projection for marked Lab28."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
import selectors
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

source=Path('/home/andy/.codex/worktrees/parallel-delivery/sandbox-crypto')
head='1deb9b72eae6e62cfa7c5592cd6f5970409743c7'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lab28_acceptance',source/'.agents/labs/kernel_lineage.py')
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
helper=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(helper)
helper.guard(head)
evidence=json.loads(helper.bounded(helper.EVIDENCE,4*1024*1024))
assert 'idle-complete' in evidence and 'resume-complete' not in evidence
expected=evidence['idle-complete']['environment'];assert expected['state']=='stopped'
marker=json.loads(helper.bounded(helper.MARKER,2048))
cli=Path.home()/'.local/opt/openshell-0.1.3/bin/openshell'
lab=helper.LAB
env={**os.environ,'XDG_CONFIG_HOME':str(lab/'config'),'XDG_STATE_HOME':str(lab/'state'),'XDG_DATA_HOME':str(lab/'data'),'OPENSHELL_LOCAL_TLS_DIR':str(lab/'state/openshell/tls'),'OPENSHELL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED':'false'}
command=[str(cli),'sandbox','get',expected['sandbox'],'-o','json']
child=subprocess.Popen(command,env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
raw=bytearray();deadline=time.monotonic()+15
try:
 assert child.stdout is not None
 os.set_blocking(child.stdout.fileno(),False)
 with selectors.DefaultSelector() as ready:
  ready.register(child.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ)
  while True:
   remaining=deadline-time.monotonic();assert remaining>0,'Gateway deadline exceeded'
   if not ready.select(min(remaining,.1)):continue
   part=os.read(child.stdout.fileno(),min(65536,524289-len(raw)))
   if not part:break
   raw.extend(part);assert len(raw)<=524288,'Gateway output exceeded cap'
 assert child.wait(timeout=max(.01,deadline-time.monotonic()))==0,'Gateway request failed'
finally:
 if child.poll() is None:child.kill();child.wait(timeout=5)
 if child.stdout is not None:child.stdout.close()
value=json.loads(raw)
assert (value['name'],value['id'],value['phase'])==(expected['sandbox'],expected['sandbox_id'],'Stopped')
proof={k:value[k] for k in ('name','id','phase')}
proof.update({k:marker[k] for k in ('run_id','source_head','helper_sha256')})
helper.guard(head)
helper.write_new(helper.GATEWAY,json.dumps(proof,indent=2).encode()+b'\n')
public={'command':['openshell','sandbox','get',expected['sandbox'],'-o','json'],'gateway_raw_bytes':len(raw),'gateway_raw_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'projection':proof,'read_at_utc':time.time()}
Path('/tmp/lab28-gateway-projection.json').write_text(json.dumps(public,indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS exact original immutable VM Stopped gateway projection')
